title: Idempotent receipts + server test
desc: Product name routing by pattern (Money_500, Trail_X...), PurchaseId saved in the profile (ProcessedReceipts) plus an in-flight lock, a server pre-check before prompting, prompt cooldown, server-wide luck boost, gamepass sync on load.

title: Receipt service with product maps
desc: Small receipt service: waits for the profile, asks each owner service (boosts, rebirth packs, poses, packs) to grant by product id, returns NotProcessedYet when a grant fails, exposes an entitlements query.

title: Gamepass ownership as attributes
desc: Checks each configured pass on join, mirrors ownership to OwnsGamepass_<key> player attributes, updates on purchase, and registers pass-based boost percents with a boost aggregator.

title: Prompt with context + announcements
desc: Server-side prompt that remembers a pending purchase and context string, routes the grant by context, checks the client context against the configured product id, logs Robux spent and posts a rich-text 'X bought Y' message with verified/premium glyphs.

title: Starter pack with playtime countdown
desc: One-time packs with reward lists, a starter pack that expires after N seconds of playtime (ticks only while online), pack status query for the UI, and cash packs scaled to the player's income.

title: Premium membership perk
desc: Gives Roblox Premium members a cash boost: checks MembershipType, listens to PlayerMembershipChanged and PromptPremiumPurchaseFinished, lets the client open PromptPremiumPurchase.

title: Boost aggregator (pass/premium/rebirth sources)
desc: Registry of named boost sources (gamepass, premium, index, rebirths...) summed into one multiplier, with a per-source breakdown pushed to the client HUD.

title: Products/passes as callback tables
desc: Per-player Purchases object: products and passes are database entries with a callback, pass ownership checked with Promises on join, PurchaseId cache in ProcessReceipt.

title: BIG Games ProcessReceipt
desc: BIG Games framework receipt: looks the product up in a directory with a Callback, retries finding the player for a few seconds, pcall's the callback, fires analytics/client events, logs failures loudly.

title: Config-routed receipt (beginner friendly)
desc: Readable receipt controller: product name from a config module, then reward tables for speed, items, carry upgrades and cash, with lazy-required systems and a client notification.

title: Classic PurchaseHistory DataStore
desc: The classic pattern: a PurchaseHistory DataStore keyed 'userId:purchaseId' checked before granting, a handler table keyed by product id, pcall'd handlers, and the purchase recorded after success.

title: ReceiptRouter (idempotent receipts + gifting)
desc: One ProcessReceipt: product table with grant/canBuy functions, PurchaseIds remembered in the buyer's data, in-flight lock, gift products with a server-validated target, prompt helper with cooldown.

title: PassesAndPremium (ownership + perks)
desc: Game pass ownership checked on join and on purchase, mirrored to Pass_<Name> attributes, OnOwned perk callbacks, Premium attribute kept in sync.

title: TimedBoosts (stackable potions)
desc: Pure functions for stackable timed boosts stored in player data, in real-time (expiry timestamp) or playtime (counts down only while online) mode.
